fork_rule: latest true newline/sentence boundary at least 8 tokens into the natural trajectory and no more than 32 tokens before its first completed forbidden-word occurrence; prior prefix legal, at least 20 alphabetic characters, and no answer marker
support_reference: checkpoint-and-family-specific natural prefix NLL distribution at the exact token length of each candidate, all length-eligible rollouts irrespective of legality
support_caveat: Audit reference sample is small; a typical likelihood is necessary but does not guarantee semantic reachability
scope_stop: no transition beyond E01; no substantive pilot before audit validity review
